mapper.update: UPDATE d_ticket_category AS ticket INNER JOIN d_program_session AS session ON session.id = ticket.session_id INNER JOIN d_program AS program ON program.id = session.program_id SET ticket.available_stock = ticket.available_stock - #{quantity} WHERE ticket.id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND ticket.available_stock >= #{quantity} AND ticket.ticket_status = 1 AND ticket.status = 1 AND session.session_status = 1 AND session.status = 1 AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= session.sale_start_time AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP <= session.sale_end_time AND program.program_status = 1 AND program.status = 1
